answer: Send every new identity on a supervised voyage: it starts at dawn with zero trust and must finish a chain of small, randomly assigned jobs, each checked by a different established peer, before it can earn. Each completed job stains its record with a pigment of verified work that cannot be bought or transferred, while failures reset the voyage. A Sybil operator must therefore pay the full time and labor cost of a real voyage for every fake identity, with no shortcut for a thousand copies.
